annotations.title: Payout wallet check: has an x402 seller's payout wallet changed?

description: Check whether an x402 seller's payout wallet changed before you pay it: compares the wallet its live 402 quote names with the wallet its Coinbase Bazaar listing last settled to and with the seller's own /.well-known/paycheck.json. An undeclared change is how a hijacked endpoint looks; a declared rotation passes. Pass or review with reasons, plus the listing's 30-day payers. Never pays or signs. Use before paying a seller you bought from before. Example: url=https://agent-data-tools.revmesh2074.workers.dev/weather. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
